body:
Effexor + MDMA = Nothing
This was my first time ever trying ecstasy. I had heard that anti-depressants (SSRI's in particular) lessened the effects of MDMA.I am on an SNRI (effexor) but decided to try it anyways.  I made sure I ate some salty snacks and ensured I was properly hydrated before even leaving home to head to a friend's. I arrived and immediately took one cap. Waited a good two hours and generally felt nothing. I took one more, waited two more hours, still absolutely nothing. In conclusion,
due to me being on an SNRI (175 mg or more) ecstasy did not work. If anything, I felt mild physical effects (i.e., light sweating, slightly increased thirst). Twenty bucks wasted.
